# Bookmark Button Checklist: Bookmark Button in the Reader

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the requirements for the reader's bookmark icon (placement, state and scope, the tap, the message, look and size, strings, data, coordination, test coverage) before tasks are written.
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Placement

- [ ] CHK001 Is "far left, under the juz number" tied to a measurable position (edge distance, vertical centre on the second row, the first row's end side)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Contracts ui.md Place]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the room reserved for the icon defined as a size (48 px at the end of the second row), not only as "do not overlap"? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, Plan research D1]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the 48 px target reconciled with the 36 px row and the 84 px bar, with the bar height and the page rectangle stated as unchanged? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-010, Plan research D1]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the placement requirements stated for landscape, for hidden bars (the icon goes with the bar) and for a zoomed page? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the behaviour of «اجعلها موضعي», the pill and the «اليوم» chip stated for the narrowest window (320 dp, 2x font), including which of them shrinks first? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-013]

## State and scope

- [ ] CHK006 Is "the current scope" defined once, with the wird / browse / no-wird cases, and used the same way in the spec, the data model and the contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Data Model Scope]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the icon state required for a switch of the active wird and for entering or leaving browse mode, not only for page changes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it stated what the icon shows for a page whose only bookmarks belong to another wird, and that a removal never touches them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the case of several bookmarks of the current scope on one page (added from the sheet) specified for the icon, the removal and the undo? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Are wird deletion (its bookmarks become general) and a backup restore (the whole table is replaced) specified for the icon state? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the state before the first answer from the database defined (outlined) and bounded in time? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases, Plan research D2]

## The tap

- [ ] CHK012 Is the double-tap rule measurable (what a second tap does while the first is being written, and after it) and consistent between FR-009 and the plan's busy rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Plan research D3]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "undo exactly" defined by the fields that come back (id, page, owner, note, time) and by the order in the sheet? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007, §SC-009, Data Model BookmarkToggle]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the lifetime of «تراجع» stated (only while the message is shown, only for that tap, not after the reader is left or the page turns)? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the failure of a write (disk full, database closed) specified for the icon, the message and the data? [Exception Flow, Spec Edge Cases, Plan research D3]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it stated that a wird deleted between a removal and its undo makes the restored bookmark general? [Edge Case, Plan research D3, Gap in spec]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the list of things a tap must not change (position, khatma count, today's portions, reminders, last viewed page, settings, page turn) complete and testable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §SC-006]

## The message

- [ ] CHK018 Are the exact message strings and the action label specified for both outcomes, with the page number format (Western digits) stated? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions, Contracts dart-interfaces.md]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the message position defined relative to the bottom bar, the page number and the icon, for visible and hidden bars? [Clarity, Contracts ui.md The message, Gap for landscape]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "stays a few seconds, the default length" quantified or tied to the platform default, and is the replacement by a new tap stated? [Ambiguity, Spec Assumptions, Plan research D4]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the message required to be readable by a screen reader, and to stay when accessibility navigation is on? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Look and size

- [ ] CHK022 Are the icon colours for both states and both looks named as tokens, with the 4.5:1 rule and a fallback if a token fails? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, Plan research D6]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the behaviour at the three reading sizes stated (the icon belongs to the bar and does not scale with the page) and consistent with the bar's own behaviour at a large system font? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the combinations of looks, sizes, screens and modes enumerated so that "12 of 12" in SC-003 can be counted? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK025 Are the tooltip text, the screen-reader label, the value (state) and the button role specified, in both states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Contracts ui.md States]

## Strings and confirmation

- [ ] CHK026 Are all seven Arabic strings listed in one place, and is the owner's confirmation a task that blocks "done" (Constitution VI)? [Traceability, Spec Assumptions, Plan research D8]
- [ ] CHK027 Do the strings of the spec Assumptions, the contracts and the plan match word for word? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions, Contracts]

## Data and backups

- [ ] CHK028 Is "no schema change, no migration, backups unchanged" stated together with the fact that restored ids and times are kept on undo? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Plan Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK029 Is it stated that the icon and the «علامات» sheet read the same list and cannot disagree after an add, a delete or a restore? [Consistency, Plan research D2, Spec §FR-005]

## Coordination and tests

- [ ] CHK030 Are the files touched and the order of edits in the shared tree stated (`reader_screen.dart` last, one commit, `git status` first), with the khatm dua lines named as untouched? [Dependency, Plan research D7]
- [ ] CHK031 Is every contract (repository methods, controller state, widget, strings, UI states) mapped to at least one test written before the code? [Traceability, Plan Project Structure, Contracts]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the geometry baseline defined as numbers recorded on the unchanged code, for which rectangles, screens and looks, before the first edit? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, Plan research D9]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the phone check specified with its steps, its stop rule (never unlock, ask before input or install) and the owner's own check as the last item? [Completeness, Plan research D10, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the requirement that a bookmark change does not rebuild the Mushaf page measurable, and is its test named? [Measurability, Plan research D2, Gap in spec]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Items marked [Gap] name a requirement that is in the plan or the contracts but not (yet) in the spec; fix the spec or accept the plan as the source.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
